tools.name: extract_product
tools.description: Turn a product page URL (or raw HTML) into clean JSON: name, brand, SKU/GTIN/MPN, price, currency, availability/in_stock, images, rating, review count and every offer, read from schema.org JSON-LD, microdata and OpenGraph. Add include=markdown for an LLM-ready Markdown copy of the page, or include=j
